title: A customer question about Free Plan Storage

question.author: member_216
question.body: I need a short answer about free plan storage. What should I expect according to the official documentation?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Storage Limits documentation says: The current limit is 10 GB. The CloudBox free plan includes 10 GB of storage, shared across all files you own. This limit applies to the total size of your synced files plus anything you upload through the web app or mobile clients. File versions and recycle bin contents do not count toward your quota. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
